intro: Announcements, meeting dates, and minutes from the association. Pinned items stay at the top of the list.

items.title: Waste collection timing this week
items.summary: A sample announcement about when households should put waste out.
body: This is a sample announcement. Replace it with the real collection days before you treat the site as official.
Households are asked to keep waste at the gate only during the collection window announced by the committee. Please do not leave it out overnight.

items.title: Minutes of the September residents' meeting
items.summary: A sample set of minutes, so the download and the notice page can be checked.
body: This is a sample. It is not a record of a meeting that took place.
The linked file shows how minutes can be opened, printed, and kept with the notice.

items.title: Street-light complaints noted for follow-up
items.summary: A sample note that a common lighting problem has been listed for the section office.
body: This is a sample notice. Use this shape when a real lighting or drain problem is being followed up.
Residents can still call the electricity helpline on 1912 for a failed supply. The association notice is only for the shared follow-up.

items.title: Monthly meeting proposed for November
items.summary: A sample meeting notice. The date is not confirmed.
body: This is a sample. Do not treat the November date as a real meeting until the committee publishes it.
A real notice should say the date, the time, the place, and how a household can send a matter for the agenda.
